breakdown.description: The prompt mixes true and engineering measures by using the current area and current length while asking for engineering stress and engineering strain.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly computes a 'current cross-sectional area' of 122.40 mm² and then uses it to calculate 'engineering stress' (12000/122.40 = 98.04 MPa). This directly repeats the original error of mixing true/instantaneous measures with engineering measures. True engineering stress must use the initial cross-sectional area (122.72 mm²), yielding approximately 97.78 MPa. The ground truth prompt removes any reference to current area or current length, keeping the calculation purely in engineering (nominal) terms, but the generated specification retains and applies the incorrect current-area approach.
